title: Review-sheet decisions export (bound)
description: The decisions.json a review sheet downloads/auto-saves, under the H1404 binding standard: a superset of the csl_pyutil.render_review_sheet v0.3.x export payload ({sheet_id, generated, decided, items:[{id, decision, note}]}, plus the standard-layer 'rating' and the strict-review 'reviewer'/'reviewedAt'/'complete' fields) that additionally REQUIRES content_hash, the sha256 of the exact sheet HTML the reviewer voted in. Pre-standard exports lacking content_hash are legacy: schema-invalid here, admissible only through validate_decisions.py --allow-legacy.

sheet_id.description: Stable sheet identifier stamped into the HTML (var SHEET_ID) and echoed by every export; the localStorage key is 'review-sheet:' + sheet_id.

generated.description: Generation timestamp of the sheet (core download) or of the export (auto-save path uses new Date().toISOString()).

decided.description: Count of items with a non-null decision at export time.

content_hash.description: sha256 (hex, lowercase, 'sha256:' prefix) of the pre-stamp sheet HTML, LF-normalized — computed by review_binding.stamp() and recorded in the sheet's committed <sheet_id>.lock.json.

reviewer.description: strict_review layer: reviewer identity typed into the sheet.

reviewedAt.description: strict_review layer: ISO timestamp when the export passed the completeness policy, else null.

complete.description: strict_review layer: whether the export satisfied the policy (all votes cast, reject notes present).

id.description: Card id, exactly as rendered in the sheet's ids array.

decision.description: The vote; unvoted items export decision:null.

rating.description: V1/V5 rating layer (e.g. Direct Assessment 1-5); absent on sheets without a rating config.
